tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin dang 'brel ba'i sri gnon rab brjid rdo rje'i ri dbang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na moḥgu ru mañdzu shrī maṇ+ḍal de wa bh+yaḥ gang zhig snying rje khros 'khrug nag po yi// bdud sde dgra bgegs zil gnon tshar gcod pa// rgyal kun gsang gsum mthu stobs 'phrin las nus// gcig bsdus phyag rgya zil gnon rtsal la 'dud// de yi las byang mchod phreng dang sbyar ste// sri gnon phyogs sgrig ngag 'don bltas chog pa// rab brjid rdo rje'i ri dbang 'dir bshad bya// de la 'dir byang gter phur pa'i phrin las kyi sri chung bcu gsum mnan pa nyid rtsa bar bzung*/ bka' brgyad rang shar gyi thod pa la brten nas mnan pa'i gzer kha dang*/ nag rtsis 'byung ba rin chen kun 'dus kyi rgyud las wang the 'phrul gyi rgyal pos sri rab khol du byung ba sogs man ngag tu sdeb cing*/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyi gnon pa'i las byang kun tu bzang po'i mchod phreng dang sbyar ste bshad par bya'o// de yang sngon srid pa chags pa'i dus ri rab kyi dbus nas shing yongs 'du sa brtol skyes pa'i rtsa bar ya bdud thod pa'i phreng ba can dang*/ ma bdud pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma gnyis 'dus pa las/ bu sri chung bcu gsum skyes pa sogs byang gter phur pa las bshad cing*/ byang gter bka' brgyad kyi sri rab ltar na/ sri yul gling dgu'i sri mkhar thod pa dgu brtsegs su sri'i mes po gnam sa'i sri gnyis las/ pha gnam gyi bya nag dang*/ ma sa yi byi ba gnyis 'dus pa la sgo nga bcu gsum skyes pa rdol ba las sri chung bcu gsum byung ba/ gu ru pad+mas brtul zhing mnan pa'i lo rgyus byung ba ltar rjes 'jug rnams kyi tshul de ltar lag len du ltar zhing mnan dgos pa'i/ de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba bca' bsham bgyid tshul la gnyis kyi dang por dngos gzhi cho ga'i bca' bsham ni| las gzhung gi rten gtor/ mchod gtor/ sman raka zor gtor/ tshogs sogs gzhung ltar tshang bar bsham pa dang*/

thun rdzas bsgral chen zor thun sogs tshang bar bsham/ gnyis pa las mtha' 'phrin las kyis bca' bsham ni| las gzhung gi dkyil 'khor gtor ma sogs kyi mdun 'og tu/ sri chas rnams 'jog cing*/ liṅga rnams mnan rdzas kyis gnon cing byad thag mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo la btag de la sri chas 'god tshul ni/ dang po dmigs bya'i liṅga bri ba la/ shog bu gtsang ma la khyad par rang gi dri mas ma gos pa gal du che zhing*/ bri snag kyang de ni shin tu gtsang ma rang gi dri mas ma gos pas bri'o// bri bya mi lus mgo bo dbus mi/ g.yas spra/ g.yon sprel/ steng bya yi mgo dang mgo bo bzhi pa can/ rkang pa bya sder can/ yan lag dang mgul du lcags sgrog brgyab pa bri ba ni dam sri'i liṅga spyi mthun no// bye brag so sor bri na/ lus dang yan lag snga ma ltar la/ pho sri dkar po spyang ki'i mgo can/ mo sri mthing nag rnga mong gi mgo can/ chung sri sre mong mgo can kha dog nges med dam/ yang na bsrung bya'i gdon ngos bzung ba dang bstun la/ gdon chen bco lnga'i gang gnod kyi mgo can nam/ spyi ltar na phag mgo can gcig khyi mgo can gcig ra mgo can gcig dang gsum bri'o// bdud sri nag po khyung gi mgo can/ btsan sri dmar po 'ug pa'i mgo can/ rgyal sri dkar po bya pho'i mgo can/ dam sri nag po phag mgo can/ klu sri sngon po sbrul mgo can| dgra sri sngo skya g.yag mgo can/ gri sri dmar po shwa ba'i mgo can/ rgan sri dang dur sri dmar skya wa yi mgo can/ byad sri ser po rta yi mgo can/ zhing gi lo sri la 'gong po spun gyi liṅga gsum bri dgos par/ gnam 'gong bya mgo bar 'gong sprel mgo sa 'gong sbrul mgo can dang gsum bri/ god sri nag po ra dang 'phar ba spyang ki'i mgo dang gsum can bri bar bya ste/ de dag gang bri yang spyi bor mun pa gtib pa/ sta zur gnyis la me 'bar ba/ gsang bar rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa/

rkang mthil rlung g.yo ba/ spyi bor nas ri rab bang rim bzhi ldan gyi mnan pa rnams bri bar bya'o// de dag la gnas yig ni/ spyi bor non bya ba bri/ de bzhin dgra sri'am chung sri gang dmigs kha bsgyur du dpral bar tri dzaḥ dam sri tri dzaḥ lag g.yas kyi dpung pa dzaḥ g.yon la hūm̐/ rkang pa g.yas la baṃ/ g.yon la hoḥ gsang gnas su phaṭḥ snying khar dzaḥ kha sprad bris pa'i dbus su tri bri/ rkang mthil gnyis su yaṃ re re/ spyi bo'i ri rab kyi bar rim bzhi la g.yas nas rim bzhin/ laṃ/ suṃ/ stam+bhaya/ nan rnams bri/ rna bar 'on/ mig la long*/ kha la dung dung*/ brla gnyis la brla dag gam dmod sri gang yin kha sgyur tshig gang tshud bri/ de rnams kyi sngags mgo liṅga'i mgo phyogs su bstan pa bri/ snying ga'i dzaḥtriḥ za yi steng nas brtsam ste sngags 'dis bskor// oṃ sarba dza tri hūm̐ dzaḥ na tri su tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ shan+t+ri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ ka tri ni dan+t+ri ni guṃ guṃ dza dza dza hūm̐ oṃ sarba tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ su tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ shan+t+ri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ ka tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ ni tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ gruṃ gruṃ gruṃ dza dzaḥ gnya' pa lag ring tri dzaḥ nan yam shud dmar po tri dzaḥ nan the'u rang stong sde tri dzaḥ nan srin mo spun dgu tri dzaḥ nan 'gong po spun dgu tri dzaḥ nan gnod byed dam sri tri dzaḥnanaḥ ces bri/ lte bar sngags snga ma 'di rnams la khyad par du hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pa'i tshab tu/ rbad nan| bcug pa dang*/ tri dza yi tshab tu/ tri mā ra ya nan/ bcu drug pa ma gtogs snga ma lta bus bskor/ lus kyi mtha' gang dmigs kha bsgyur bskor du spyi bor nas brtsams te sngags 'di'i bskor/ oṃ sarba tri ni rbad nan su tri ni rbad nanaḥ shan+t+ri ni rbad nan ka tri ni rbad nan ni rbad nan gruṃ gruṃḥ trig nan u na e hur breng shags rbad thuṃ dzaḥ oṃ log tri pā la nanaḥ sa ga pa sha nanaḥ na ga du du nanaḥ ma maṃ ma maṃḥ tsi tsa raḥ

tsi tsa raḥ baṃ ru lu rbad kra ko sha ya/ rbad tra ko sha ya/ ho ra ho ra nan/ gnod byed rtsi du sod/ lus shig hur gtub/ ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba thul/ ka wa tsi gnod byed phung sri zhes spyi tshang yin te dmigs bya bsgyur kyang chog 'og ma kun la 'gre'o// sri pho mo mā ra ya nanaḥ lkong lkang du ra du ra hab sha hab sha gnod byed pho mo skyugs shig skyugs shig kha tham kha tham: mchu chings mchu chings/ dan+dha dan+dha bhan+dha ye swā hāḥ ha shaṃ tri ru ti ba ti sha sha rbad nan/ tri'u tri'u tu tri kha sha tri'u dzaḥ ra tri ye rbad nan| du tri tri rbad ya tri ni mā ra ya rbad nan/ raṃ baṃ ril ru tri be te na rbad nan/ sarba na tri ni rbad nan/ su tri ni rbad nan/ shan+t+ri ni rbad nan/ ka tri ni rbad nan/ gruṃ gruṃ phung sri pho mo'i srog la tri mā ra ya rbad nan/ gnod byed 'byung po pho mo a mu ka snying du nan tri du nan dzaḥ tri nan snying gzer rbud nan gnya' pa lag ring tri dzaḥ stam+bha ya nan/ rgyal po the'u rang tri dzaḥ oṃ sum+bha ya nan gnod byed dam sri che chung sri god sri dgra sri gnod byed 'byung po bse rag the'u rang ma mo rgyal 'gong gnod byed pho mo sarba ka ya wak+kā tsit+ta hūm̐ lam stam+bha ya nan: tri dzā/ tri briṃ mā ra ya su tri yak+ṣa da ra ṇi dzaḥ gnod byed 'byung po phung sri pho mo chings chings/ nan pak+ṣa pak+ṣa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃganod byed rengs rengs gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa gnod byed mā ra ya rbad nan khums shig khrag skyugs shig nan chings chings phung sri pho mo nan che sri chung sri nan phugs kyis sris la za ba nan gnod byed 'byung po phung sri thams cad staṃ bha ya nan/ ces bya ba bri/ zhing gi lo sri yin na gnas yig rnams snga ma ltar la/ khyad par bla gnyis la liṅga gsum so sor/ gnam gyi 'gong po tri dzaḥ bar snang gi 'gong po tri dzaḥ sa yi 'gong po tri dzaḥ

snying kar phaṃ yaṃ yaṃ/ yang liṅga nam mkha' la g.yugs shing*/ ling khrus 'di las rgyas 'dod na logs su shes so// de nas liṅgar lag rjen gyis mi reg shing skyer pa'i skam pas 'dzin par bya'o// de nas rang phyogs kyi gnas khang dang rten gsum rnams mi bzhugs pa'i sa 'gol sar phyin nas/ khrag sna dug sna'i gtsang rdzas rigs rnams me la bsreg pa'i dud pas liṅgar bdug cing*/ rang gi kha snar dri ma ma shor bar 'dzems/ de nas liṅgar byug rdzas ni/ yi ge rnams kyi yig 'bru rnams la zhib par brtags la sngags sogs kyi shan 'byed nges la/ lha sngags kyi rigs la 'bru sman spos sna rin po che sna tshos kyis byugs/ drag sngags la dug khrag gzhung chen rnams nas byung bzhin bsgrub pas ngar blud pa yang yod/ gnod byed rnams kyi ming dang sngags la khrag sna dug sna dang mi gtsang mnol rdzas gang 'dzoms byug dgra rkun lta bu la ni de'i byug rdzas gang rnyed byug par yang bshad kyang 'dir ma dgos de lta bu'i liṅga de phyal mo tshud pa'i 'brub khung kha rub cing gting zab pa/ phyi rim du se skyer 'om gsum gyis gtsang dmar srin mo 'gros dang*/ mtshe yungs gzugs pa/ kha chod bar srub kyi seng med par byed rgyu yod pa'i nang du bkod pa'i liṅga'i srog yig la byad thag gi sne mo spra tshil lta bus sbyar bar byas/ 'di gtso bo'i gtor ma zhal phod na de'i zhal btab ba phyag len yin/ ra yi sog pa'i me long 'di yi mthil du sri gang yin dang mthun pa'i tri yig bri ba'ang yod ba ra rta gsum gyi 'o ma dang go kha'i thal ba sbyar ba'i thal skyo/ sri bshos 'brang rgyas/ sri yos yos tshig ba tshwa bul tog lan tshwa gsum/ de rnams so sor bsham/ thun rdzas ni gri lcags kyi lcags phye/ zangs phye/ dkar gong dang dur khrod rdo nag thog rdo ri gzar rbab rdo sogs phye/ ke tshe shang tshe| lung thang rtse/ yungs kar nag

'tshe sna phye ma rnams so/ bal tshon sna lnga'i tshon skud kyi snal ma/ sri gnon pa'i snod thod pa'i bshad pa ni/ pho sri gnon na g.yag rog po'i thod pa/ mo srir khyi mo nag mo'i thod pa/ chung srir sre mong gi thod pa'am/ khyi ra rta gsum gyi thod par bcug pa'am/ so sor bris pa'i phag mgo can de bcug pa sre mong ngam rta thod/ ra mgo can de bcug pa ra thod du/ khyi mgo can de bcug pa khyi thod dang gsum lags so// btsan srir nya thod sram thod dung dkar dang gsum gang rung*/ dam srir ra khyi phag gsum gyi thod pa gang rnyed/ klu srir khyung gi thod pa/ dgra srir spyang ki'i thod pa/ gri srir dgra thod gri bo mdze pho gang rung gi thod pa/ rgan sri ra dang dur sri khyi/ wa grum pa gsum gyi thod pa gang 'dzoms/ god sri khyi gu phag gu re'u lug gu sogs chung gsum gyi thod pa'o// god thod lha srir khyung rgod glag gsum gyi thod pa/ 'gong po dang the'u rang la ri bong gi thod pa/ zhing sri la rwa yi rwa co/ de las gzhan dmigs su mi bsal ba rnams khyi thod kyi 'thus par bshad/ sri rigs gang gnod pa/ lo zla zhag dus kyi sri sogs dang sbyar na thod pa'i bshad pa dang thun gyi bshad sogs sa bdag spyang ki'i nang gi 'jigs pa'i lce gdung bcu gsum du blta bar bya'o// thod pa de rnams gang yin kyang dpral bar rgan sri nan/ gzhon pa'i gzhon sri nan bya ba bri/ 'gram pa g.yas la pho sri nan/ g.yon la mo sri nan bya ba bri/ khyad par du god sri god thod du gnon na god thod de yi ltag par g.yung drung bon skor bri| dpral bar rdo rje rgya gram bri/ rna ltag gnyis la khram rgya gram bri/ 'gram pa g.yas par god sri kha tham bya ba bri/ g.yon pa god kha chod bya ba bri/ thod par god sri thams cad brub bo mnan no bcad do ma ldangs shig bya bar bri/ thum ni re ba dang yug sa'i sha gos gang rung*/

se skyer 'om gsum gyi rtsang ste gnyis kar phur so ltar zur gsum byas pa mang tsam rdo rje rgya gram ris bris pa'i the'u la cha/ rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i ro g.yam sam/ rab chad kyi rang 'thag la ri rab gling bzhi bris pa sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bshams pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim pa ni/ las gzhung bka' brgyad ltar na/ las byang*/ gter srung*/ mchod bskang*/ tshogs las sngon du btang*/ gser skyems gzu dpang nas sri rab la 'jug tshe bdag las byang gi gzhung bsrang dzab bzlas nas/ ya mān+ta ka gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ / sogs bzod gsol nas/ tshogs lhag ma song nas/ bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong sngon rol du/ / sogs chad mdo/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*/ / sogs gser skyems sam/ bka' drin 'khor med rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ / sogs mkhyen gsol gzu dpang bskyed/ de nas mnan pa'i gzer kha las| mnan pa'i las dngos bstan pa la/ sngon gyi byung tshul bstan pa/ bar du mnan tshul bstan pa/ tha mar gnon tshul bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po byung tshul ni zhes gsungs pa/ kyai: sri yul gling dgu bya ba na: sri mkhar thod pa dgu brtsegs na: dang po sri yi mes po ni: gnam sri gal dang gol ba yin: sa yi cha ma chod dgu yin: de gnyis byung ba'i byung tshul ni: ya ma dam sri zhes bya ba: sngon tshe dam tshig nyams las skyes: sri mo ma des dgu shor te: sngon tshe lta ba log las skye: de gnyis sri ru langs pa yin: pha gnam gyi bya nag gshog chags dang : ma sa yi byi ba khra mo gnyis: de gnyis sred cing sprul pa las: srid pa'i sgo nga bcu gsum byung : gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus spyang ki'i mgo can byung : gnas pa ri bo'i rtse la gnas: za ba skyes pa pho la za: ming ni pho sri ral can zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus rnga mong mgo can byung : gnas pa rgya mtsho'i gting na gnas:

za ma mo yi sri la za: ming ni mo sri za byed zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus sre mong mgo can byung : gnas pa lam gyi 'og na gnas: za ba byis pa chung la za: ming ni chung sri phung byed zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus khyung gi mgo can byung : gnas ni bdud ri'i rtse la gnas: za ba mo yi sri la za: ming ni bdud sri nag po zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus 'ug pa'i mgo can byung : gnas pa btsan gyi ri la gnas: ming ni btsan sri dmar po zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus bya pho'i mgo can byung : gnas pa lha khang nang na gnas: ming ni rgyal sri dkar po zer/ gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus phag gi mgo can byung : gnas pa lung gsum mdo na gnas: ming ni dam sri phung byed zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus sbrul gyi mgo can byung : gnas pa rgya mtsho'i gting na gnas: ming ni klu sri sngon por zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus g.yag gi mgo can byung : gnas pa dgra bo'i mtshams na gnas: ming ni dgra sri dar ma zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus sha ba'i mgo can byung : gnas pa mtshon gyi rtse la gnas: ming ni gri sri ngan pa zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus wa yi mgo can byung : gnas pa mchod pa'i steng na gnas: ming ni rgan sri ral can zer: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed na: mi lus rta yi mgo can 'byung : gnas pa ri gu'i mgo la gnas: ming ni skyes pa'i byes sri zer: skyes pa byes su song ba'i tshe: gtam ngan yul du sleb pa dang : rta pho byes su song ba'i tshe: sga stan khyer nas yong ba'i sri: gcig ni brtol ba'i nang shed nas: mi lus ra yi mgo can byung : gnas pa ra ba'i phug na gnas: ming ni god sri byan mo zer: phyugs lug ra ba stong pa'i sri: de dag sri yi byung tshul yin:

gnyis pa ni/ de nas sri yi mnan tshul ni: slob dpon chen po pad+ma yis: sri can gnon du byon pa'i tshe: sri can 'khor dang bcas pa yi: zangs zhu dgu ni mgo la gyon: sla nga dgu ni brang la bkab: 'bring zhags dgu ni ske la bcing : sta re dgu ni sked la btsugs: phyogs rnams kun tu phyin pa las: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : 'gyur med thang la thug ste 'phrad: sri can nang nas gdong drag pa'i: sri lcam dra ma bya ba de: skad cig nyid la bros la shor: sri can spun dgu'i lcam cig ma: de yi mchod nas 'di skad zer: slob dpon chen po tshur gson dang : nga ni sri lcam dra ma yin: ming po sri can spun dgu yin: nga yi pha ma 'khor dang bcas: skye 'gro kun gyi sri ru che: khyed hab kyis za'i hub kyis 'thung : de skad tsam zhig zer ba dang : slob dpon chen pos 'di ltar gsungs: nga ni khyod kyis thub pa'i gang zag min: lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bur ldan: sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs: chos skyong srung ma bran du 'khol: khyod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun: nga yi 'khor g.yog bran du byas: de skad gsungs pas sri mo bros// de nas slob dpon chen po yi/ sngags dang phyag rgyas bcings nas bkug /ngag tu yang ni 'di skad brjod// kye/ sri can 'khor bcas 'dir shog cig /de ring tsam las dga' ba med/ 'di na rin chen gzhal yas khang*// mthong ba tsam gyis spro ba bskyed// dga' zhing brod pas gnas 'dir shog /sri can rgod cing 'dur zhing shog /glu len bro brdung yod pas shog /ri rab tsam gyi zas kyang yod// rgya mtsho tsam gyis skom yang yod// sha gsur dud pa snom du shog /'ja' tshon lus la gyon du shog /'phrul gyi me long blta ru shog /skyo ma bal skyo 'dag tu shog /lha yi gzhal yas blta ru shog /dung khang nang du nyal du shog /gser zan khams su za ru shog /de skad tsam zhig gsungs pa dang*// las kyi dbang gi sri can rnams// rang dbang med par mdun du bkug

/phyag rgya chen pos zil gyi mnan// dus dang gnas skabs de tsam na// sri mo bya ba'i las ngan de// gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du// nam gyi phar phyed tshur phyed la// rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// rta nag gcig la zhon pa rmis// thang nag gcig la phyin pa rmis// gser zan khams su zos pa rmis| /skyo ma bal skyo 'dag pa rmis// dngul dkar me long bltas pa rmis// dung khang nang du nyal ba rmis// lus la 'ja' tshon shar ba rmis// g.yas su thog cig bab pa rmis// g.yon du 'brug cig ldir ba rmis// bar du glog cig 'khyugs pa rmis// gzhal yas khang du phyin pa rmis// sri rmi lam mkhan gyi bshad du gsol// de skad tsam zhig brjod pa dang*// rmi lam mkhan gyi lan btab pa// sri mo las ngan tshur nyon dang*// de ring phan chad su dang 'phrad// sri 'dul chen po zhig dang ma 'phrad dam// rmi lam mi bzang rmi lam ngan// g.yas su thog cig babs pa de// rdo rje dril bu dkrol ba yin// g.yon du 'brug cig ldir ba de// gsang ba'i rnge'u chung ldir ba yin// bar na glog cig 'khyugs pa de// slon dpon lce ni glog ltar 'khyugs// gser zan khams su zos pa de// sbang zan kham gsum za ba yin// skyo ma bal skyo 'dag pa de// thal skyo nur mo 'dag pa yin// 'phrul gyi me long blta ba de// ra sog skya mo blta ba yin// 'ja' tshon lus la shar ba de// bal tshon sna lngas bcings pa yin// rta nag gcig la zhon pa de// 'gal pa kha nag zhon pa yin// dung khang nang du nyal ba de| /khyi thod skya mor bcug pa yin// glu len bro brdungs byed pa de/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i bro rdung yin// sri can pho mo 'gugs pa yin// de skad zer ba thos pa dang*// sri mo dam sri las ngan de// la dgu lung dgu brgal nas bros// slob dpon chen po pad+ma yis// pho nya mgyogs byed bskul nas ni// drag po'i stobs kyis myur du 'gugs| /thar sa med pa'i rgya cig btab// de nas sri mos 'di skad smras// slob dpon chen po tshur gson dang*// sri can bros kyang 'gugs pa de// dgos don ci zhig yod pa yin| /de skad tsam zhig smras pa las// slob dpon chen pos 'di ltar gsung*// khyod sri can 'khor dang bcas pa yi// 'gro ba kun la gnod 'gal byas// da ni dam sri gnon pa yin| /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod 'gal byas:

rdo rje slob dpon sku dgra byas: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu khyod la tshang : bsad cing mnan pa'i dus la babs: de skad tsam zhig gsungs pa dang : sri mos 'di skad lan btab bo: kye slob dpon chen po bdag la gson: spyir mi rigs sum brgya drug cu la: sri can 'khor bcas ma gtog pa'i: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu yod: yang bgegs sum brgya drug cu yod: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga yod: tshe rabs bgrangs ba'i lha 'dre yod: phral la gnod pa'i rkyen bgegs yod: las kyi dbang gi gnod 'gal byas: de dag sri yi lan pa min: bdag cag sri can lan pa min: dus kyi dbang gi gnon 'dod na: thod pa'i thod rab bshad kyang 'tshal: mi rigs sum brgya drug cu la: thod bsdus sum brgya drug cu yod: de dag gang dang gang la zer: btsal kyang mi rnyed thod gsum yod: mnan pas mi non thod gsum yod: mnan du mi rung thod gsum yod: med thabs med pa'i thod gsum yod: mnan mi dgos pa'i thod gsum yod: mgo las ma byung thod gsum yod: shing las ma byas mgal gsum yod: de dag gang dang gang la zer: 'gro gsum thod pa gang la zer: 'dzul gsum thod pa gang la zer: 'phyo gsum thod pa gang la zer: de skad tsam zhig zer ba dang : slob dpon chen pos 'di skad gsungs: btsal kyang mi rnyed thod gsum po: bya khyung ka ru'i thod pa dang : seng ge dkar mo'i thod pa dang : g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i thod pa yin: mnan pas mi non thod gsum ni: btsad po dar ma'i thod pa dang : ban bon dar ma'i thod pa dang : bram ze dar ma'i thod pa yin: mnan du mi rung thod gsum ni: yongs kyi dge bshes thod pa dang : dge slong khrims ldan thod pa dang : rnal 'byor rtogs ldan thod pa yin: med thabs med pa'i thod gsum ni: du ru phag gi thod pa dang : ku ku ra dza'i thod pa dang : tshe tshe ra yi thod pa yin: mnan mi dgos pa'i thod gsum ni: rgya mo sna ring thod pa dang :

hor mo spyi ring thod pa dang : mon mo nag mo'i thod pa yin: mgo las ma byung thod gsum ni: phyag tshangs ku ba'i thod pa dang : bya mo nag mo'i sgo nga dang : khams pa sa las grub pa gsum: shing las ma byas 'gal gsum ni: ra ru gnyer ma can dang gcig: lug ru khug pa de dang gnyis: g.yag ru lding ba de dang gsum: khyung rgod glag gi thod pa gsum: lding gsum lding gi thod pa yin: sha 'gros rna 'gros rkyang 'gros gsum: 'gro gsum 'gro yi thod pa yin: wa 'dzul byi 'dzul grum 'dzul gsum: 'dzul gsum 'dzul gyi thod pa yin: nya 'phyo sram 'phyo dung 'phyo gsum: 'phyo gsum 'phyo yi thod pa yin: de skad tsam zhig gsungs pa dang : yang cig sri mos 'di skad zhus: kyai: slob dpon chen po tshur gson dang : lding gsum lding gi thod pa de: dgos ched gang dang gang la dgos: med thabs med pa'i thod pa de: med thabs gang dang gang la med: tshwa dang bul tog ba tshwa gsum: dgos ched gang dang ci la dgos: bal tshon sna lnga ci la dgos: ba ra rta yi 'o ma de: dgos pa gang dang gang la dgos: ro g.yam rdo rje rgya gram de: med thabs gang dang gang la med: gu gul dud pa gang la dgos: skyer pa'i tsher ma ci la dgos: de skad tsam zhig zer ba dang : de nas slob dpon 'di skad gsungs: lding gsum thod pas lha srin 'dul: 'phyo gsum thod pas btsan sri 'dul: 'gro gsum thod pas god sri 'dul: 'dzul gsum thod pas sgos sri 'dul: 'phyo gsum thod pas tshe sri 'dul: ra khyi phag gsum thod pa de: dam srid 'dul na dgos pa yin:se skyer 'om bu'i rtsang rnon de: dam sri gsod pa'i mtshon cha yin: gu gul nag po'i dud pa de: lha dang dbye na dgos pa yin: dug chen du ba bul tog gsum: rdzongs gsum 'debs pa'i rdzas yin no: ba ra rta yi 'o ma de: thal skyo byed pa'i khu ba yin: bal tshon sna lnga'i skud pa de: sri can 'ching pa'i thag pa yin:

ro g.yam rdo rje rgya gram de: sri can gnon pa'i g.yam pa yin: slob dpon chen pos de skad gsungs: sri mos yang gcig 'di skad zhus: pho sri ldang na gang nas ldang : pho sri brdzu na gang nas brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog ji ltar 'byung : gnon pa'i thod pa gang la byed: mo sri mnan na gang du mnan: mo sri ldang na gang nas ldang*/ mo sri brdzu na gang du brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog ji ltar yin: gnon pa'i thod pa gang la byed: mnan sa gang dang gang la byed: dgra sri ldang na gang nas ldang : dgra sri brdzu na gang du brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog ji ltar 'byung : dgra sri gnon pa'i thod pa gang : mnan sa gang dang gang la byed: dur sri ldang na gang nas ldang : dur sri brdzu na gang du brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog ji ltar 'byung : dur sri gnon pa'i thod pa gang : mnan sa gang dang gang la byed: phung sri ldang na gang nas ldang : phung sri brdzu na gang du brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog ji ltar 'byung : phung sri gnod pa'i thod pa gang : mnan sa gang dang gang la byed: god sri ldang na gang nas ldang : god sri brdzu na gang du brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog ji ltar 'byung : god sri gnon pa'i thod pa gang : mnan sa gang dang gang la byed: chung sri ldang na gang nas ldang : chung sri brdzu na gang nas brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog ji ltar 'byung : chung sri gnon pa'i thod pa gang : mnan sa gang dang gang du byed: de skad tsam zhig zhus pa dang : slob dpon chen pos 'di ltar gsungs: pho sri gangs dkar steng nas ldang : brdzu ba g.ya' dang gangs la brdzu/ dbyibs dang kha dog dkar la 'tsher: gnon pa g.yag rog thod par non: mnan sa gangs dkar steng du non: mo sri rgya mtsho'i gting nas ldang : mo brdzu khyi mo nag mor brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog mthing la nag: khyi mo nag mo'i thod pa ru: mnan sa rgya mtsho'i gting du non: dgra sri la btsas 'og nas ldang : brdzu ba lcags kyi spyang mor brdzu:

dbyibs dang kha dog sngo la skya: spyang ki sngon po'i thod par non: mnan sa la btsas 'og tu non: dur sri dur gyi sgab nas ldang : brdzu ba wa mo dar mar brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog dmar la skya: wa mo dar ma'i thod pa ru: mnan sa dur gyi 'og tu non: phung sri grogs po'i nang nas ldang : brdzu ba rnga mong gwa ba brdzu: rnga mong gwa ba'i thod pa non: mnan sa grogs po'i nang du non: god sri ra ba'i phug nas ldang : brdzu ba 'phar spyang gnyis su brdzu: 'phar spyang gnyis kyi thod par non: mnan sa ra ba'i phugs su non: chung sri mal gyi 'og nas ldang : brdzu ba khyi gu phag gur brdzu: res 'ga' re'u lug gur brdzu: dbyibs dang kha dog gang yang ston: chung gsum thod pa'i nang du non: mnan sa mal gyi 'og tu non: de nas sri yi lan ma thebs: de tshe slon dpon pad+ma yis: sri rnams mnan pa'i dus la babs: gnam gyi bya nag gshog chags de: nyin mo pho brgya'i sha la zaḥ nub mo mo brgya'i khrag la 'thung : nang nub byis pa phyags mas gdab: ma rnams bu dga' zer ba la: sri can rnams kyis za res babs: bu dga' zer ba'i gnas su 'byung : khyod kyi pha yang ngas kyang zos: da yang khyod la za res babs: de bas sring mo chung mar gnang : zer ba gyur pa thos ma thag: ming pos sring mo'i sa ru phyin: sring mos ci nyes dris pa la: ming pos sngar gyi lo rgyus bshad: de nas sring mos 'di skad smras: ming po de la ma 'jigs shig: ngas shig de ru phyin nas kyang : pha yi mi sha blangs shig zer: nang gros byas nas sring mo phyin: bud med g.yo dang khram che bas: chung mar byas nas kha bslu byas: ci la 'jigs zhes dris pa las: sde brgyad yongs la nga mi 'jigs: thog rje btsan la nga mi 'jigs: brngan pa byin nas gsod du bcug: thog rje btsan pos 'phrang la bsgugs: 'gyur ba med pa'i sri dang 'phrad: mda' rgyab dpral ba'i dbyings su thebs: chung mas ngu brdzu rgyas nas brdzus:

khyod la sus brgyab mi 'chi yi: nga yi blo ltos su la 'cha': zer zhing mtshang nas brus pa las: sri yi bden snyam snying gtam smras: ma ngu nga ni mi 'chi yis: bla ru byi'u chung bdun yod pas: byi'u chung de rnams ma shi na: kho bo bsad kyang 'chi re kan: de skad zer zhing snying gtam bshad: chung mas yang gcig kha rku byas: bla yi byi'u chung bdun po de: gang za gang 'thung gang du nyal: cir brdzu 'bod na gang du 'bod: 'bod pa'i rdzas ni ci zhig yin: de skad byas pas 'di skad zer: bla yi byi'u chung bdun po de: nyin mo gangs kyi steng du nyal: mtshan mo rgya mtsho'i gting du nyal: 'bod na rgya mtsho'i gting nas 'bod: lci ba ser ka'i dud pa dang : mi rkang gling bu'i sgra dang bcas: sri skad lan gsum bos nas song : de ltar byas nas nam phyed na: yong ngo byas te rtsol ba byas: rin po che'i byi'u chung bdun: rgya mtsho de'i 'gram du byung : yas bzung de ni mgo nas bzung : mas bzung de ni rkang nas bzung : ra khyi phag gsum thod par bcug: bal tshon sna lngas rgya ching byas: rdo rje rgya gram 'og tu mnan: de ru sri yi bla zhig bsad: de byas de thub gnon pa yin: zhes pa'i bar sri rab kyi tshul du gtong : de'i 'phros las gnyis pa bar du gnon tshul bstan pa ni: dang por gzugs bca' ba: bar du dgug gzhug bya ba/ tha ma mnan pa bya ba dang gsum du bshad pa ni/ gzugs bca' ba sngon du song zin te: gnyis pa dgug gzhug bya ba'i sngon du/ mnan pa'i gzer kha las/ pho nyas dgug par gsungs pas/ hūm̐: dpal chen sri 'dul chen po ni: 'jam dpal sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs bzhengs zil gnon lha tshogs bzhengs: sri ngan 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: sbyor sgrol dbyings yum ma gsum bzhengs: sri ngan 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig / de bzhin du 'di man 'gres/ bka' brgyad kyi mtshan bsgyur/ ye shes bzhi yi lha tshogs bzhengs:

sri ngan 'gugs pa'i= gyad gnon sprul pa lha brgyad bzhengs: sri ngan= sku sprul 'chi bdag yab yum bzhengs: sri ngan= gsung sprul srog bdag yab yum bzhengs: sri ngan= thugs sprul tshe bdag yab yum bzhengs: sri ngan= gsang ba'i gshed bzhi yab yum bzhengs: sri ngan= nang gshed yab yum brgyad po bzhengs: sri ngan= yang sprul phyi gshed yab yum bzhengs: sri ngan= nyid sprul zla gshed bcu gnyis bzhengs: sri ngan= zhag gshed sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhengs: sri ngan= sgo bzhi'i sgrol ging 'khor bcas bzhengs: sri ngan= za ma'i gshed chen drug cu= sri ngan= gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu= sri ngan= las gshed pho nya 'khor bcas bzhengs: sri ngan 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas 'jam dpal

sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha he ru ka: shin tu khros nas phung sri 'gugs pa'i phyir: gshin rje'i las byed thams cad pho nyar 'gyed: lcags kyu dkar mo'i tshogs ni skar ltar 'phro: zhags pa ser mo'i tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs: lcags sgrog dmar mo'i tshogs ni glog ltar 'gyed: dril bu ljang mo'i tshogs ni thog ltar 'bebs: thams cad khros pa'i nga ro 'brug las che: rgyug pa'i shugs ni bar snang 'khyugs las myur: gtum pa'i brjid ni gnam sa 'phar zhing ldeg: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs gar 'dug mkhyen: lcags kyu'i snying zungs zhags pas ske nas chings: lcags sgrog gis sdoms dril bus mnyes bzhin du: las kyi rlung dmar 'tshub pa'i khar skyon la: gzugs byang 'di la bstim pa'i dus la babs: a+ye ring sham bur 'di btag bzla/ gnod byed phung sri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gnod byed phung sri a yur+dz+nyā na a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gnod byed phung sri tri ya ni a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gnod byed phung sri rūpa skan+dha a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ pra we sha ya phaṭḥ liṅga'i khog phyer der bstim phyir/ a we sha ya ā: de nas brub khung bskyed pa ni/ e las brub khung 'di nyid gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom: las kyis gshin rje'i btson khang*/ ngam nag la gting ring ba: dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i 'og tu sleb pa/ 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba/ zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba| gti mug gi mun pa gtib pa/ nga rgyal gyi brag ris gtam pa/ phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshub pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bab pa/ dug dang nad thams cad kyi na bun 'thibs pa cig tu gyur/ liṅga bskyed pa ni/ de'i nang du tri las phung sri nag la haṃ pa/ sngo la rid pa/ shin tu nyam thag pa/ gan rkyal du bsgyel ba mig shi mig tu lta ba/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa gcig tu gyur/ dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ lci ba ser ka ma/ ra sha'i ra tshil/ mi rkang rta rkang rnams me la bsregs pa'i gsur dud dang bcas te/

na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*| chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi= khro bo'i rgyal po 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po phyag rgya zil gnon gyi bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'= bden pa chen po 'di yi byin gyis brlabs kyi/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa/ phug gi sris la za ba/ mi dang phyugs kyi srid la rku bar byed pa'i dam sri/ phung sri/ che sri/ chung sri/ dur sri dgra sri god sri pho mo gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad skad cig yud cig la dmigs pa'i nya ho dkar byang du bris pa 'di la/ lcags kyu can rnams kyis khug cig zhags pa can rnams kyis chings shig lcags sgrog can rnams kyis sdoms shig dril bu can rnams kyis mnyed cig lan gsum byas la/ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum: phyag rgya zil gnon bde gshegs bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas: ma lus bka' yi bden pa dang : chos nyid rnam dag rgyu 'bras zab/ phyag rgya lha sngags ting 'dzin mthus// brtan 'grogs gnod byed dgra bo dang*// dam sri 'byung po gdon gyi rigs// khyad par bdud po thod phreng dang*// ma bdud gar dbang gnyis tshogs bu// rgyal blon yul khams phung ba'i sri// dam sri dgra sri god sri dang*// sgos sri chung sri dur gyi sri| /g.yal mo'i god sri stong pa'i sri// che chung zhang tsha rje khol sri// ma bu phu nu lcam dral sri// yod med sri sogs sri ngan gyi// bla srog rnam shes rten 'di la// khug chings sdoms myos lha dang dbye// dbyer med ngo bo cig tu gyur// mnan pa'i gzer kha ltar/ che sri chung sri dgra sri god sri phung sri dur sri me sri/ chu sri/ mtshon sri/ dam sri la sogs pa'i sri rigs thams cad skad cig la dzaḥdzaḥ

zhes kyang brjod/ skabs 'dir mdzes rgyan du rin chen kun 'dus ltar/ sri mo dga' yin dga' yin shog /sri mo rgod kyin rgod kyin shog /lcam mo 'dur gyin 'dur gyin shog /do nub tsam las dga' ba med do shog: do nub tsam las gzha' ba med do shog: dga' bo gzha'o yod do shog: bro brdung glu len byed du shog: ri rab zas su za'o shog: rgya mtsho skom du 'thung du shog: 'ja' tshon lus la gyon du shog: 'phrul gyi me long blta ru shog: dung khang nang du 'dzul du shog: gzhal yas khang la blta ru shog: spos kyi dud pa bsnam du shog: gsur gyi dud pa bsnam du shog: sri sha kham gcig za ru shog: sri zan chang cig za ru shog: sri chang hub cig 'thung du shog: sri yos sun cig 'gam du shog: de nas bla 'gug pa'i sngags ni/ ༈ sri mā ra ya mā ra ya shog: sarba dza tri ni dza shogaḥ sri mo guṃ guṃ shog: ka tri ni dza shog: shan+t+ri ni dza shog: na tri ni dza shog: su tri ni dza shog: du tri ni dza shog: sri mo guṃ guṃ shog: sri mā ra ya shog: oṃ ya mān+ta ka sri ngan dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sri ngan gyi bla sha re ma ti 'grims 'grims: sha ma ru ti thul thul: myog myog: yed yed: sha ma ru ti khug khug ling myog ling shag ling thum tsa mun+t+ri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes bla 'gugs kyi sngags bzla/ de ltar dgug zhugs dang bla dgug gi sngags 'di spel la 'bung*/ de yang lan rer sngags brgya phrag mang po'am gang 'grub byas la/ yang dgug gzhug byed pa yin/ de lta bu lan grangs bdun nam gsum sogs byed pa yin/ 'di dus sri 'gug pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro bo lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thog pa mang po dpag tu med pa spros/ sri yul gling dgu ri bo'i rtse/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram sogs sri rigs so so'i gnas yul rnams dang*/ khyad par gang dmigs kyi sri'i gnas yul thams cad gang bros sa med pa srung 'khor gyi ra bas bskor/

pho nya lcags kyu can rnams kyis dbang med du bkug zhags pa can rnams kyis dam por bcings/ lcags sgrog can rnams kyis 'gul mi shes par bsdams/ dril bu can rnams kyis dran med du myos su bcug skad cig rang dbang med par byi'u khras ded pa ltar byung ba gzugs rten rnams dang gnyis med du 'dres/ bcings/ brten par bsam pa rtse gcig tu dmigs/ 'di la khug rtags ma byung bar du dgug pa kho na gal du che la 'gugs pa la yang tshig sngags tsam gyis khug par mi 'gyur ba'i/ lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin gal du che zhes/ rang nyid lha'i bskyed rim gyi nga rgyal/ pho nya spro 'gugs kyi gsal snang de dag kyang ting 'dzin ye shes kyi 'khor los zin pa/ lhag par rang nyid nus stobs kyis gdug pa can de rnams yid g.yo bar mi nus pa'i/ skyabs yul rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa gnad du che bar/ rang 'dod sha stag ma yin pa'i snying rje'i sems bskyed/ mos pa'i gdung ba bcas/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum la gsol btab thugs rje nus rtsal bden pa'i stobs kyis dpung grogs rgyab brten dang bcas pas/ gnod byed thams cad mi yong dbang med du bsam pa gcig dril du bya'o// rtsa bar sri rnams khug ste bred nas slob dpon la phyag byas par bsam la/ sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso: bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i thugs: dkyil 'khor lha dang slob dpon la: lus ngag yid gsum phyag bgyid do: de'i lan du/ phung sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod: tshe rabs snga ma'i lan chags kyis: dus 'di nyid du sri rnams byung : rnal 'byor nga yi gshed mar byung : khyod ni bsgral ba'i zhing yin gyi: gsang ba'i gnas 'dir 'dus 'tshogs shog: tri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥdzaḥ gnod par byed pa'i phung sri 'di: tshe rabs snga ma'i lan chags kyis: dus 'di nyid du sri rnams byung : sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di yi bshig: dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis phrogs:

yon mchod rnams la gnod pa'i bgegs: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i sri: skad cig tsam gyi 'dul ba'i phyir: gru gsum 'bar ba 'dir gsol zhig: da lta nyid du mchis par gyur: nor gyi dogs nas ming rus bris: brlag gis dogs nas ling gar byas: zag gis dogs nas thod par bcug: khyod kyi rdul brlag bya ba'i phyir: da lta nyid du 'dir song zhig: yang*/ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum: zhes pa nas snga ma ltar/ da ltar nyid du 'dir song zhigaḥ zhes pa 'di yan lan gcig bskyang la/ ༈ yod med sri sogs sri ngan dang : phung sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod: snying nas khugs cig badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ phung sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod: ske nas chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: phung sri= yan lag sdom shig badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: phung sri= myos par gyis shig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: gu gul gyis 'dug cing thun rdzas rnams kyi brub khung du rdeg tshul tshig dang bstun te/ dzaḥ gu gul sbyar bas sri bdug pas: gnod pa sri mi rdzu 'phrul nyams par shog: chang dang dug khrag sna tshogs pa: drag po'i dmar gtor mtshon dbal brdar: lcags zangs mkhar gong skye tshe dang : dkar nag yungs thun gyis brab pas: gnod pa sri yi rdzu 'phrul nyams par shog: oṃ sarba dza tri hūm̐ dzaḥ na tri su tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ shan+t+ri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ ka tri ni dan+t+ri ni kuṃ guṃ dza dza dzaḥhūm̐: zhes bzlas pa 'dir nan tan du bya'o// sngags 'dir 'dra min mang kyang phur lugs ltar bkod pa yin| mnan pa'i gzer kha ltar na/ oṃ sarba tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ su tri ni hūm̐ dza: shan+t+ri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ ka tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ ni tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ gruṃ gruṃ gruṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes gsungs pa yang gang 'grub tsam bzlas na legs| bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sprul pa'i pho nya khro bo khro mo/ mtshon cha dug dbal/ nad rlangs mi bzad pa spros/ 'od kyi dmigs bya sri la phogs pas mthu dang*/

rdzu 'phrul stobs dang gzi brjid thams cad me tog la ba mo phog pa bzhin song*/ khro bo khro mos bcom ste lo thog la ser ba drag po phog pa bzhin du gyur/ dug dbal gyi nang gi don snod nyog sil du btang*/ mtshon chas phyi'i lus dang dbang po yan lag rmas nad kyi zin pas phyi nang gi lus ngag yid gsum gzir zhing myos/ dud rlangs kyis 'tshub pas brgyal zhing dran med nyam thag pa'i rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam pa yengs med nyag gcig tu bya'o// zhing rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang snying rje'i dbang gis thugs rje drag po'i skur bzhengs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer khro bo khro mo/ mtshon cha dug dbal/ nad rlangs mi bzad pa spros/ 'od kyi dmigs bya sri la phogs pas mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs dang gzi brjid thams cad me tog la ba mo phog pa bzhin song*/ khro bo khro mos bcom ste lo thog la ser ba drag po phog pa bzhin du gyur/ dug dbal gyi nang gi don snod nyog sil du btang*/ mtshon chas phyi'i lus dang dbang po yan lag rmas nad kyi zin pas phyi nang gi lus ngag yid gsum gzir zhing myos/ dud rlangs kyi 'tshub pas brgyal zhing dran med nyam thag pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur bar bsgom pa dang*/ mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das sogs dmigs pa drag tu bya/ sngags tshan gnyis las gzhung lugs kyang ci mang dang rjes kyi sngags kyang ci 'gror bzlas/ oṃ sarba dza tri ni rbad nan/ na tri ni rbad nan/ su tri ni rbad nan/ ni tri ni rbad nan/ shan+t+ri ni rbad nan/ ka tri ni rbad nan/ dan+t+ri ni rbad nan/ gruṃ gruṃ gruṃ dzaḥdzaḥ mā ra ya rbad nan/ 'di dag gi tshe lag len ni zhal las shes par bya dgos so// rjes kyi dmigs khams dang*/ mdun bskyed dmigs pa bya ba gong gi 'gugs dmigs la'ang rigs 'dres bya'o// phur pa'i sri chung bcu gsum gyi rtsa ba las/

'gugs 'dren bya/ stongs grogs dang 'bral ba la sogs bya zhing gzugs la dbab bo// zhes gsungs pas/ gu gul gyis bdug la/ rin chen kun 'dus las/ dam nyams dgra bral 'gugs pa'i phyir: 'go ba'i lha dang phral ba'i phyir: gu gul sbyar ba'i dud pa yi: dam sri 'byung sri'i snar bdug pas: gnod par byed pa'i 'byung po dang : sri can mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrogs: zhes dang*/ las gzhung bzhin bya rog 'ug pa'i dang rus byab cing*/ hūm̐: las kyi gshin rje thams cad dang : bdag gi srung ma dam can rnams: phung sri'i lha lnga dbang du bsdus: phung sri'i yul lha mnan du chug: sri ngan lha dang gyes su chug: sri lha yang ni 'thor du chug: ma lha ma sman yar du chug: srog lha dang ni phrol la shog: oṃ ka ka mu kha mthu mo che: mthing nag chen mo bya rog dbu: rtog med zas su sha la dga': khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: hūm̐: hu lu mu kha mthu mo che: ser nag chen mo 'ug pa'i mgo: nyin mtshan med par 'jig rten rgyu: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: lha dang sri ru phrol la shog: lus dang srung mar phrol la shog: khyod dang chung mar phrol la shog: pha dang bu ru phrol la shog: gnyen dang nye ba phrol la shog: pho bo nu bo phrol la shog: lha srung nyams kyi mtha' la bdos: phung sri rdul du brlag par gyis: e ring gi sham bur 'di btags la bzlas/ gnod byed phung sri de wa ka pa ye e dza la dza la/ ra tsa phye/ a shag shag ya ma phye/ ya ma phye ya/ spu ra spu ra/ yus yus/ lang lang*/ seng seng*/ phus phus/ gnod byed phung sri yul lha dang phye| dgra lha dang phye/ srog lha dang phye/ pho lha dang phye/ mo lha dang phye/ de nas gshag gdab 'di ltar bya/ hūm̐ dam sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod/ dug gsum nyon mongs dbang du song*| gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor (('dir ma dper ldeb ngos gcig mi 'dug )dpyad )bka' la mi gdags su// phyin chad ngan song dgag par byed//

ces brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ sna tshogs me tog phreng bas bcings pa ni/ sogs kyi mchod cing*/ lha yi rgyal po lha mchog gshin rje gshed// sogs sh+lau kas bstod/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang*// sogs kyi gzhung bzhin bsdus la thun grol lo// rtsa bar/ de ltar dus drug tu g.yeng ba med par gdab sngags dang sri sngags kyi gcun la brdeg go /zhes gsungs pa thun drug gam bzhir bya zhing de la thun sngon mar gzhung bsrang ba 'di bzhin byas la/ thun phyi ma rnams la las byang mi gyer ba'i/ ya kun gzhi ma bcos ye rdzogs chen po'i klong*// dran rig ye shes rang gsal snang ba'i mdangs// skad cig brdzus skyes tshul du bdag nyid bskyed// 'jam dpal khros pa las kyi gshin rje gshed// sku mdog mthing nag drag shul chen po'i gzugs// rab khros 'jigs su rung la rngam pa'i zhal// gnam sa tsam gdangs mche ba ri ltar gtsigs| /ljags spyod khams su ma lus shar za zhing*// srid pa'i khrag gis rab myos dmar ba'i spyan// shin tu zhud pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// smin 'khyogs bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar zhing 'khyil// khro gnyer gsum ldan shangs kyi bu ga nas// 'jig rten 'thor ba'i rlung dmar mi bzad g.yo// sma ra ag tshom rdo rje me stag 'phro// khams nag ral pa phyed mar gyen la brdzes| /phyed ma thur 'phyang rting par sham mo ba// nam mkhar gdeng pa'i phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub rtser// gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa// mi bzad drag por bskor zhing phyag g.yon na// gnod byed kun 'joms lcags kyi tho ba bsnams// sbrul dang thod phreng stag gi sham thabs can// klu gnyan sa bdag lha chen ma he mnan// zhabs gnyis rgya mtsho'i gting du gar bsgyur ba// srid pa'i rtse nas lcags sreg sa gzhi'i bar// sku bongs kyis mnyam snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs// thams cad bral khol ci bsgo'i phrin las bsgrub// stobs ldan me rlung 'khrug pa'i dbus su gsal//

zhes bskyed la e ring gang 'gro tsam nas e thung brgya tsam bzlas/ de nas/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sogs gser skyems phul| bka' drin 'khor med sogs gzu dpang bskyed/ de nas sri rab sngon ltar/ kye sri yul gling dgu bya ba na// zhes pa nas/ de byas da thub mnan pa yin// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ pho nya dgug pa/ hūm̐: dpal chen sri 'dul chen po ni: sogs/ chos kyi dbyangs nas 'jam dpal he ru ka: sogs sngags bzlas/ brub khung liṅga bskyed pa ni/ eḥ de mdun dgra bgegs ma lus brub pa'i khung*// dug gsum las kyi btson khang gru gsum pa// 'dod chags mtsho 'khrug zhe sdang me dpung 'bar// gti mug mun gtibs kha rub gting zab pa// zin nas thar med gshin rje'i lcags khang na// tri bstan pa'i spyi dgra rnal 'byor sgos kyi dgra// dam nyams phung sri nag la rid pa'i gzugs// nyam thag mya ngan 'dug stangs rkang lag bcings// mngon sum lta bur gsal ba nyid du gyur// dgug gzhug ni/ bla ma yi dam mchog gsum rab 'byams lha// gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas bka' bden pas// rnal 'byor bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// thog mtha' bar du sdang zhing gnod sems pa'i// gnod byed phung sri'i bla srog rnam shes rnams// gnam sa gling bzhi gling phran ri rab seng*// nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i skyobs// mdor na 'khor 'das srid pa'i gnas dang rten// gang na 'dug kyang dmigs pa'i rten 'di la// lo zla zhag dang za ma'i 'gyang med pas// skad cig thang cig yud tsam nyid cig la// myur du khug cig chings sdoms myos pas dzaḥ oṃ mañdzu ya mān+ta ka ya ma ra tsa dngos 'dir gnod byed phung sri akar+ṣaya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnod byed phung sri de wa u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces dang*/ na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma/ sogs dang*/ yod med sri sogs sri ngan dang*// sogs re 'gugs sngags dmigs bcas snga ma ltar nan tan bya'o// khug rtags byung na dha ti dang liṅga'i yan lag gi sngags rnams kyang bri bzlas gnyis ka bya bar gsungs pas/

khug rtags ni rmi lam gyi skabs dang*/ shog ling bem sogs gzhung chen rnams ltar ro// dha ti dang yan lag gi sngags zhes pa 'di'o// oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza dha ti ma ma karma shi ku kraṃ kaṃ ka ra nye ya tri mā ra ya rbad/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ dbang po yan lag thams cad thul thul| myog myog mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa'i sngags tshan lnga po yang bzlas la/ lha dbye ba ni/ dang ru gnyis kyis byab cing*/ hūm̐ bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs las sprul pa'i tshogs// gshin rje'i pho nya dpag tu med 'phros pas// dam nyams phung sri'i rnam par shes pa ni// skyob byed lha dang ban bon srung ma'i skyabs// mdor na gar yod gar gnas gar 'dug kyang*// mtho ba srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas// dma' ba na rag dmyal khams yan chod du// bros dang thar pa'i rang dbang med pas na// lcags kyus snying zung zhags pas ske nas chings// lcags sgrog gis bsdoms dril bus myos byas te// skyob byed 'go ba'i lha kun ring bskrad nas// 'jigs pa'i mun pa nag pos mdun bsus nas// las kyi rlung dmar 'tshub pas rgyab nas ded// lha srin dregs pa'i hab sgra di ri ris// rang dbang med par btson bzhin khrid nas kyang*// gnam lcags 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskor// 'joms byed tho bas spyi bo'i gtsug nas brdungs| /dzab bzlas sngags kyi 'od zer pho nya'i tshogs// rno ba'i dbal dang dug gi nus par ldan// 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar phab// drag po thun gyi sha rus dum bur bsil| /phur bus snying btab bla srog rbad kyis bcad// khong seng nas drang tshe bcud bdag la thim// dngos grub gsos gyur bkrag mdangs gzi byin rgyas// phung sri bcud bral dbang med nag skem song*// bla dang rnam shes dbang stobs mthu nyams nas// nus med mar me 'chi kha'i 'od bzhin pa// 'gul spyod bros pa'i go skabs bral bar gyur// gu gul sbyor bas sri bdug pas// gnod pa sri yi rdzu 'phrul nyams par shog

/chang dang dug khrag sna tshogs pa// drag po'i dmar gtor mtshon dbal bdar// lcags zangs mkhar gong skye tshe dang*// dkar nag yungs thun gyis brab pas// gnod pa sri yi rdzu 'phrul nyams par shog / ces brjod kun gyis brab cing sngags 'di brjod/ oṃ hūm̐ trig khrom bh+yo: ma ṇi mā ra ni bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yoḥ rak+mo rak+ṣan bh+yoḥ ting ya rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ mā ra ya ya ma rā tsa kī la ya bh+yoḥ ces gang mang bzlas/ sham bur 'di btag oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma tha/ e du rak+ṣa/ sa pa tring phur nṛ tri gha/ nṛ a bh+yo dzaḥ gnod byed sarba trig nan bh+yo bzlog mā ra ya thum shig dang bzlas pa dang bzlas dmigs snga ma ltar la 'bad/ dgong mo'i thun tha ma'i dus/ skabs 'dir chos skyong gi gtor 'bul sogs byas la| mthar na mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum zhi khro'i tshogs// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs// sngags 'chang bdag gi bskyed rim lha sngags nus// ting 'dzin 'jam dpal bshol srang 'phrin las mthus// gshin rje gshed po dregs pa'i lha srin tshogs// ma lus 'khor bcas bka' bden bden mthu 'dis// bla ma'i sku dgra bstan dang sems can gnod| /dngos 'dir sdang zhing gdug pa'i sems ldan pa// snga dgra lag bdar phyi dgra yid la sems// da lta gnod cing 'tsho ba'i dgra bgegs sri// kha 'jam gting rtsub zhe gnag mthus dgo can// do brdo phod btsugs bsam ngan sbyor rtsub pa// lhar bsnyeg mthu nus bu lon ltar bsnyegs pa// 'gro lam gtsang 'jug za lam dug sbyor shoms/ mgo thog g.yam pa rkang 'og rdel byed pa'i// dmigs bya'i dam nyams kun dang khyad par du// phyogs mtshams steng 'og phyi nang thams cad nas// ban bon la sogs mi dang mi ma yin// pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i las brtsams pa// byad kha phur kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong mthus// ngag mnan dbyen dkrug bskrad gzir rmongs reng bshor// mnan gtad hom bsreg gtor zor rbad bsad bcings| /'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo 'gong chog ngan sngags sdebs// rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan dang mi kha sri// dug sbyor khram kha sho rdel rdzas nus 'phrul// phra man rigs sngags ngan pa'i gnod pa kun// ma lus da lta nyid du phyir bzlog la// skad cig 'jam dpal phyag gi nyi zla'i bar// byad ma brdab bsad phyed mar brlag pa'i rdul// me chu rlung gi lhag med bsreg gtor bas| /dmigs med ngang du bzlog cig sa ma ya// gnod byed rdul phran bzhin du brlag gyur cig

/byad mkhan rang gi gshed du rbad ya bzlog /e sa bh+yo bzlog dgra la rbad ya bzlog /kham shag ro myag mug ti rbad ya bzlog / ces yang bzlog sham bcas/ dmod mo dang sbrag thun gtor yod na 'phangs/ thal mo rdab rjes dmigs med rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod bstod do// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang*/ ces sogs kyi rjes chog lhag chad kha bskang dang yig brgya/ bkra shis bsngo smon gyi mtha' brgyan par bya/ thun mtshams sogs spyod lam rnam bzhir rgyun khyer gyi nyams len ni/ brab bzlas tshar nas brub khung de kha bcad la/ de'i steng de ru phur pa 'dzugs pa'am rten byin can bzhag mtha' thun rdzas kyi bskor la bzhag /brub khung de nyid dbang chen gser gyis sa gzhi'i 'og tu sleb pa'i gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom lcags bsreg gi sa gzhi'ang mi shig pa rdo rje pha lam las grub pa'i gshin rje'i btson khang gting ring pa/ steng 'og bar gsum bar mtshams srub med pa phyi nang dang steng 'og thams cad nad dang dug gi mun rlangs 'thul zhing gtib pa/ dug mtshon gyi char 'bab pa/ phyi rol gyi gtsang dmar rnams kyang bsrung ba'i khro bo khro mo bsam kyi mi khyab pas bsrungs pa/ phyi nas rim bzhin sa chu me rlung mi bzad pa'i gur khang bang rim mang po can du bsam/ steng du rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po las kyi tshe bdag nag pos drag rtsal stobs kyi gzir zhing mnan nas/ phung sri de nyid sgo gsum dbang med du brgyal bas 'gul spyod dang phral bar byas te/ bskal pa'i bar du yang mi gtong bar rgyas gdab brdab par bsdams/ rang nyid kyang gsal ba gsum dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas phung sri de nyid bkug gzir bcings mnan bsrung ba sogs kyi nga rgyal dang ma bral ba ni gnad kyi gdam pa'o// de lta bu'i sgrub pa rtags ma thon bar ram/

min kyang zhag gsum lnga bdun sogs ci rigs par bsgrub/ de yi phyi ring la gdong mtshams dang ngag mtshams shin tu dam par byas la nan tan du bsgrub/ tha na yun du mi bsgrub pa'i zhag cig gnyis lta bu'i mnan chog byed pa na'ang*/ thun re'i ring la'ang mtshams dam po dang*/ lus kyi spyod 'gros tshad med pa dang*/ khyad par sems g.yeng ba gzhan gyi rjes su ma 'brang ba ni bskyed rdzogs las ma 'das pa shin tu gnad kyi che ba yin no// lha sngags kyi snying po ma gtogs pa'i gong 'og gi sngags bzla tshe mchi ma khong du ma song ba phyir dor ba mnan ngag go ༈ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ las sbyor nyin mo de ni mar ngo lta bu'am mnan pa'i las la shis pa'i gza' skar dus sbyor dang 'phrod par byas la/ las gzhung gi bzlas pa yan byas bzod gsol nas/ chos skyong gi gtor bsngo mchod bstod kyi rim pa rnams song nas/ las gzhung gi tshogs dang*/ chos skyong srung ma bskang ba'i rim pa dang*/ lhag ma btang la/ slob dpon gyi mdun du brub khung de nyid dam lcags slang lta bur liṅga dkar byang de nyid dang zan ling che ba gcig bsham la/ chad mdo song nas/ hūm̐ dpa' bo 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dgra// sogs bskul rgyas pa byas/ gser skyems gzu dpang*/ brub khung dang liṅga bskyed pa/ dgug gzhug lan gsum/ pho nya bskul ba lha dbye rnams gzhung ltar gyi bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: dug lnga 'dus pa'i sdong po la: nas/ lus ngan 'di la ma zhen cig: bar las byang ltar nas/ hūm̐: 'jam dpal gshin rje sgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : ya mān+ta ka'i dngos grub stsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad: mgyogs phur blang la/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab: las gshin pho nya'i dus la=

bdud dang gshin rje'i= ma mo gnod sbyin= gtum po sgo bzhi'i= khyed rnams thugs dam= mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab: oṃ karma ya mān+ta ka badz+ra ki li kī la ya dha ti ma ma karma shi kraṃ kaṃ ka ra nye ya nṛ tri ma ra ya rbad: ces snying kar btab/ gdab phur blang lag tu bsgril zhing bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag ni 'jam dpal he ru ka /g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin las// rigs kyi yab lnga'i ngo bor gsal// g.yon pa shes rab rang bzhin las// rigs kyi yum lnga'i ngo bor gsal// thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las// mthing nag hūm̐ las skyes pa'i lha// sras mchog badz+ra ki la ya// lte ba yan chad sku stod ni// dbu gsum phyag drug rdor gshog can// dus gsum phrin las 'dus pa'i sku /lte ba man chad sku smad ni// ye shes phur pa'i dbal dang ldan// steng du bla ma dkon mchog gsum// 'chang zung tshe bdag dkyil 'khor lha// zur gsum seng la bka' nyan rnams// gnas gsum yi ger 'od zer 'phros// nya bos lus ngag yid bkrus nas// phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus// rdo rje phur pa nyid la zhugs// mthu rtsal rmad byung mnga' gsol bar// 'gying bas skrag dang g.yo tsam gyis| /khams gsum dus cig sgrol nus gyur// bsgril ba tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar// phyar ba tsab kyi khams gsum dngangs// btab na stong gsum yud kyis brlag /gnod byed dgra bgegs smos ci dgos// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ khrus lung bya ba 'di la dgongs// ye shes lha la gtad cing bsgril// de dag 'od zhu phur par thim// phyogs gtad bsgril zhing snod bcud bstim// rdzu 'phrul mthu dang ldan par bsam// phur thun dgra bo'i gshed du 'bebs// hūm̐ rdo rje phur pa kī la ya// sangs rgyas yongs rdzogs 'phrin las sku// dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlogs// bcol pa'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

ces bskul bskor zhing nya thor brdeg slar yar mgyogs phur blang nas ni/ hūm̐ dgra bgegs 'byung po las ngan 'di// dang po zhe sdang pha las brgyud// bar du 'dod chags mngal sgo 'grim// tha ma nyon mongs lnga yi gzugs// phung po rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir// srid pa'i chags pa lte ba yin// lte ba'i dkyil du kī la ya| /rnam shes chags pa snying yin pas// snying gi dkyil du kī la ya// lta bar byed pa mig yin pas// mig gi dkyil du= nyan par byed pa rna ba yin// rna ba'i dkyil du= snom par byed pa sna yin pas// sna yi dkyil du= myong bar byed pa lce yin pas// lce yi dkyil du= skyod par byed pa yan lag yin// yan lag bzhi la kī la ya// yungs thun mtshon cha thog tu bsgom/ hūm̐ yungs dkar rgyal po sha ri ram// khro rgyal yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku// sdang ba'i dgra la rbad pa'i tshe// spyi bo'i steng du thog ltar 'bebs// klad pa'i dkyil du zho ltar dkrug /snying gi dkyil du nya ltar 'phyo// sha rus bar du mig ltar rgyu// lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlogs// e ka he dun trag rak+ṣa ya/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa/ yo da ya/ ra la yo ni/ ra la k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya/ dgra bo e myag ya rubs mug shag ka dun bh+yo nṛ tri hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad/ kun mthar khrag sna nad bsam brdeg hūm̐ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /ma mo yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku/ dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlogs// bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod// mtshe thun brdeg cing 'di skad do// hūm̐ mtshe mda' drag po skar ltar 'khrug /dregs pa yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku// dgra bgegs lnga phung= bcol ba'i= dug sna nad snas brdeg la brjod/ hūm̐ gdug pa'i dug rlangs rlung ltar 'tshub// dug lnga yongs rdzogs= dgra bgegs= bcol ba'i= lcags phye la sogs mtshon char 'bebs/

hūm̐ thog ma med pa las kyi mtshon// phyag mtshan yong rdzogs= dgra bgegs= bcol ba'i= mda' thun snying la gzer bas ste/ hūm̐ dpag med drag po mda' yi thun// bdud 'joms yongs rdzogs= dgra bgegs= bcol pa'i= dur khrod rdo sogs thog char 'bebs/ hūm̐ stobs chen rtsal 'chang rdo yi thun// phra man yongs rdzogs= dgra bgegs= bcol ba'i= mtshon cha brdeg cing 'di skad brjod/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'khor lo dbyug tho sogs// mtshon cha yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku/ dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlogs// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

ces brdeg cing*/ hūm̐ pa ra bi dan tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ bin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ shī krin bī krin a na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a we sha ya a we sha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ bhi dha ya bhi dha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brab bo// de nas zor phur thogs la/ hūm̐ bran dang pho nya bka' nyan tshogs// sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pa// khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab// mngon spyod 'phrin las myur du mdzod/ ha na ha na badz+raḥ da ha da ha badz+raḥ pa tsa pa tsa badz+raḥ ma tha ma tha badz+raḥ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+raḥ mu ru mu ru badz+raḥ ka taṃ ka te dza ye bi dza ye: a tsit+ta a pa ra tsit+ta ma ra sa ni pra mar dha na ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ gri gug thogs la/ hūm̐: 'jam dpal gsang ba'i bka' las ni: sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa: stobs chen khro bo chen po yis: klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhigaḥ sa ma yā shaṃ ku ru ma taṃ nya ka ra i nan dha ti ma ma karma shrī kraṃ kaṃ ka ra nye ya/ dug khrag dang sbyar ba'i rlon thun thogs la/ hūm̐: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi: lha'am 'on te bdud kyang rung : nga la bar chad byed pa'i sri'i: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos: sarba a na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ta tha ya ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces btab bo// tho ba dang hom gzar ram/ gru srog dpyi mig gtun bu thogs la/ hūm̐: bka' las 'da' byed sdig can 'di: mtshon cha rnon pos bsgral zin gyis: khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun: rdo rje me 'dras snying bsreg nas: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces brdung ngo*// se skyer 'om gsum gtsang gi brab cing*/ hūm̐: sri las sna 'dren che ba med: sri las ni skyes ring ba med:

na ba'i gzer du che: tsha ba'i dbal du che: gson gyi bdud du che: gshin gyi gshed du che: che sri chung gi sri: rgyal sri blon gyi sri: zhang sri tsha bo'i sri: rje sri khol gyi sri: ma sri nu bo'i sri: bu sri nu yi sri: lcam dang dbal gyi sriḥ yod sri med kyi sriḥ yul sri dur gyi sri: god sri sgo yi sri: sri rnams thams cad gdul bya'i phyiraḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i skur bsgom ste: drag por gyur pa'i gtsang phur gyis: sri rnams thams cad rdul du rlogs: gshin rje'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: pa ra bi da na hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ bhin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gu gul sogs sri bdug cing thun sna tshogs kyi brab la/ dzaḥ gu gul sbyar bas sri bdug pas: gnod pa sri yi rdzu 'phrul nyams par shog: chang dang dug khrag sna tshogs dang : drag po'i dmar gtor mtshon dbal brdar: lcags zangs mkhar gong skye tshe dang : dkar nag yungs thun gyis brab pas: gnod pa sri yi rdzu 'phrul nyams par shog: ces brdeg go /de nas ral gri thogs la/ hūm̐ nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ sangs rgyas yin te ye shes sku// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ral gri yi/ log rtogs 'khor ba'i rgyun bcad de/ nṛ tri e hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: ral gris btub bo// de nas bstab pa ni/ hūm̐ tshe bdag nag po'i lha tshogs rnams// phyes shig phyes shig zhal phyes shig /don dam chos nyid zhal phyes shig /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdangs shig /gangs ri tsam gyi mche gtsigs shig /bar snang tsam gyi ljags dril la// stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa gdangs// khams gsum 'khor ba'i phung khams skye| /dgra bgegs sha khrag ma lus pa/ zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// mgul du dril lo a rā li/ dbyings su sgrol lo sa mā ya// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nam mkha' lha yi byed byed dang*// sa gzhi klu yi byed byed dang*// bar snang gnyen gyi byed byed dang*// stong gsum mi yi byed byed dang*// snang srid lha 'dre'i byed byed dang*// gling bzhi bon po mu stegs dang*// yul mi rje dang khyim mtshes dang*// 'tshe ba'i sems kyi bsam dang smra// lus kyi rtsub pa'i sbyor byed sogs// de dag gzhi rten lus sems rnams// zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// mgul du dril lo a rā li// dbyings su sgrol lo sa mā ya// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// nyams pa'i gdon dang phung ba'i sri// sri can gyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*| /log 'dren gdug pa'i ltas ngan rnams// thams cad rdul du brlag bya'i phyir// phung po khams dang skye mched rnams// dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs gzugs su bris// nya ho'i rten 'dir bkug byas nas// phur 'debs thun dang mtshon chas bsad// bsgral ba'i zhing bcu las la sbyar// dpal chen tshe bdag zhal du bstab// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstab// 'khor bcas gshin rje 'bum gyi zhal du bstab// chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du bstab// dgyes par rol gcig kha raṃ khā hi// lhag ma med par zhal du bstab// gzugs phung sha khrag mchod par bzhes// dam tshig nyams chags so sor bshags// thugs dam bskang la dngos grub stsol// bar chad rkyen ngan gdug rtsub bzlog

/bsam pa sgrub la re ba skong*// 'phrin las rnam bzhi myur 'grub mdzod// 'di yan ltar gdab las tshar nas mnan chas bya ba ni/ gtsang sbra dang lag 'bags sogs sngags bri dus bzhin du rang dris ma gos pa bya zhing*| zhing gi lo sri yin na sa 'gong gi liṅga kha yar gnam la bstan pa'i steng du bar 'gong gi liṅga yang de ltar yar bstan du bzhag de'i steng du gnam 'gong gi liṅga kha sbub la bzhag pa'i liṅga sum sbrag byed la stobs/ liṅga gang yin yang de rnams lteb dus kyi sngags dmigs dang lteb lugs ni/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dzā dha ti ma ma kārma shrī kraṃ kaṃ ka ra nye ya nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad: ces brjod la liṅga de yi mgrin pa nas mgo bo brang du sbyar la bltabs cing*| phung sri de nyid lta nyan snom smra myong lnga'i dbang po dang bral bar bsam/ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes lag g.yas stobs/ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: lag g.yon stobs/ badz+ra s+phoṭa baṃ: rkang g.yas stobs/ badz+ra ghan+ḍe hoḥ rkang g.yon stobs/ yan lag bzhi ka bcag pas g.yo bar byed pa'i dbang po nyams nas 'gul spyod dang bral bar bsam/ snying dkar nag mtshams nas stobs/ oṃ sarba dza tri ni rbad nan/ na tri ni rbad nan/ su tri ni rbad nan/ ni tri ni rbad nan/ shan+t+ri ni rbad nan/ ka tri ni rbad nan/ dan+t+ri ni rbad nan/ gruṃ gruṃ gruṃ dza dzaḥ rbad nan mā ra ya phaṭḥ byas la lus ngag yid gsum gyi dbang po dran med du nyams shing brgyal bar gyur ba'i mos pa byas/ kham sa dang yos tshig cung zad ling snying du bcug la phan tshun ltobs yas mas stobs/ de lta bu lag tshags dam por byas la dgu bltab sogs gang bde shin tu dam par byas/ de la tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram ris su dam par bcings la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i gnas lnga las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis ba thag tshon skud sna lnga'i rnam pa la/ ngo bo phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba zhi khro thams cad kyi mthu nus stobs rtsal gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid de'i phung sri'i dbang po lnga sogs bcings par bsam la bcing tshe sngags 'di bzlas/

sa ra bi dan hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ bhin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas/ snas chings kyi rgya gram mtshams su blug par rdo rje rgya gram gyi the'us rgyas btab/ slan chad kyang ji srid bskal pa gnas kyi bar du phung sri de nyid ldang mi nus par mi gshigs pa rdo rje bzhi'i phyag rtags su phyag mtshan rgya gram gyi rgyas btab par bsam/ ling ga de nyid sri 'dre so sor ched du gsal ba'i gshed thod gang yin pa de nyid du bcug thal skyo yang blug klad khung du ma dmigs bcas snga ma ltar bstab/ re ba'am yugs sa'i sha gos kyis dril nas/ thum de nyid rnam pa bskal pa'i mun pa mi bzad pa rab tu gnan pas g.yogs pa ste/ ngo bo sngon chad rgyal ba'i bka' dang dam las 'das shing sems can yongs kyi sri ru ldang bar byas pa'i rnam par smin pa'i cha las grub pa'i rgyu dang rkyen gyis/ zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs snying rjer khros pa'i gzi brjid kyis 'phrin las gang 'dul du bzhengs pa rab tu gnag cing gzhom gzhig mi nus pas rab tu g.yogs cing bsrungs bar bsam/ tshon skud sna lngas bcing*/ dmigs pa snga ma ltar byas/ bcing mtshams rnams su se skyer 'om gsum gyi rtsang phur gsum khram ris su btsugs la/ yi dam srung mar bcas pa'i mthu stobs kyi rdo rje rno ngar mi bzad pa reg 'joms mtshon cha'i gur khang me'i tsha tsha dang thog zer la sprul pa sna tshogs spro bas bsrungs bar bsam la/ slar yang de nyid e yi nang du gzhug ces pas/ grub khung du bcug la/ mnan chas byas zin pa'i skabs su 'di gyer ro// kyai: sngon gyi las ngan bsags pa yiḥ da lta lus ngan blang pa yin: sri can 'khor dang bcas pa 'di: rigs ni yi dwags rdzu 'phrul can: las ni ngan dgu gdug bcu byed:

thal ba'i mdog la skra gzings skyes: bong chung mdog che bzhin mi sdug: ltas ngan rtags su ya so rtol: sngon nas sems la gdug rtsub tshang : las ngan byas pas grub pa yin: khyod pha yi sri la bu yi sri: che yi sri la chung gi sri: nor gyi sri la phyugs kyi sri: rgyal po'i sri la blon po'i sri: bstan pa gnyen po khyod kyis bshig: dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyed kyis smad: rdo rje slob dpon sku dgra khyod: theg chen chos la khyod kyis smad: sems can yongs la gnod pa byas: rnal 'byor yi tshe bdud byas: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu khyod la tshang : brjod kyi dogs nas ling gar byas: nor gyi dogs nas ming rus bris: bros kyi dogs nas lcags sgrog brgyab: mtshon cha rnams kyis mtha' la bskor: pho nya rnams kyis 'gugs 'dren byas: rak+ta khol ma'i rbab la g.yengs: yungs kar sbyar ba'i thun gyis brab: gu gul dud pa sbyar bas bdug: skyer pa'i tsher ma snying la gzer: re ba nag po'i thum gyis btum: tshon skud sna lngas rgya chings byas: so so'i sri thod nang du bcug: klad khung la cha'i rgya yis btab: snying rje med pa'i lag tu gtad: sri khung gru gsum nang du brub: 'jig rten khams 'di ma zhig bar: nam yang thar pa'i skal ba med: nam zhig byang chub sems skyes na: yi ge hūm̐ du bsdus nas shog: ces brjod/ skabs 'dir thod dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa ni/ sri 'dre so sor che ru gsal ba'i thod pa'i mnan khang de nyid/ gnam lcags kyi sa gzhi dang*/ mi shigs pa rdo rje pha lam las grub pa'i brub khung gting ring ba steng 'og bar gsum du bar mtshams dang srub med pa/ phyi nang steng 'og nad dang dug gi dud pa 'thul zhing mtshon cha'i char bab pa/ phyi rol rnams su srung ba'i khro bo khro mo bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsrung ba/ phyi nas rim bzhin sa chu me rlung mi bzad pa'i gur khang rim pa mang po can du bsam/

rgyal ba thams cad kyi mthu stobs nus pas rgyas btab bden pa'i tshig gi gzir/ drag rtsal stobs kyi mnan par bsam/ de nyid las kyi gshin rje la gtad pas/ bzung zhing zin nas btang mi shes par bzung bar dmigs par bya'o// ༈ de nas las gzhung ltar sgo dbye lam bstan byas/ thun rdzas gtor ma sogs gang 'phen par 'os pa'i zor chas rnams dang*/ gnon par bya ba de nyid bcas zor lam du chas/ gtor tshugs byas la/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi gzugs pa: sogs bzlog pa dang chos skyong gi bzlog pa yang khyer/ mnan gzer las/ de nas mnan gnas so so yang na lam rgya gram du mnan pas thams cad non pa yin| zhes gsung ba'i/ mnan gnas so so zhes pa ni/ pho sri gangs dkar gyi steng du mnan/ mo sri rgya mtsho'i gting du/ chung sri ra'i thod pa de ma sgyed zhabs su/ sre mong thod pa can de sgo them zhabs su/ khyi thod can de lam rgya gram lam grong khyer gyi srang mdor/ spyir btang ma yi nyal 'og tu mnan par gsungs/ bdud sri bdud gcod phyogs su/ btsan sri lung gsum mdo'am la btsas 'og tu/ rgyal sri lha khang them 'og tu/ dam sri them 'og gam yang na mchod rten 'og gam lam rgya gram 'am lho phyogs kyi shing cig 'og tu/ klu sri brag bya khyung 'dra ba'i 'og tu/ dgra sri dgra sdang phyogs sam/ dgra sri phung shul du/ dur sri dur mched kyi zhabs su/ rgan sri dur 'og gam them 'og tu/ byis sri lam rgya gram 'og tu/ zhing gi lo sri lam rgya gram 'og tu/ god sri lam 'og gam ra ba'i phug gi stongs sam/ sa mdo sogs sa bcad gzhung dang bstun pa'i/ ma ṇi bum pa sogs kyi 'og tu mnan pa dang*/ dmigs su mi gsal ba rnams lam rgya gram lam grong khyer gyi srang mdo'o// sgo yi them 'og gam/ lung gsum 'dzom mdo mtshams sogs su mnan pa yin pas/ ༈ de lta bu'i gnon sa gang rigs su phyin nas/ spro na phyogs de'i gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin/

min kyang gser skyems/ gzu dpang*/ thun zor rnams rim pa bang ba dang gtor zor kyang 'phangs/ mnan gzer las/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi e brub khung bris la brub khung gting ring bar bya'o// zhes gsung pa ltar dong brus la de nyid las rang yi dam lha yi nga rgyal gyis 'di skad do// ces gsung pa ltar/ hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin: las kyi mnar ba'i dam sri 'di: skyon nam de ni mi skyon na: 'khor lo chen po'i rtsibs la skyon: mtshon cha stong gis bskor nas bzhag: rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du spyug: rol pa'i mtsho bdun bskor nas bzhag: ri rab chen po'i 'og tu mnan: gser gyi ri bdun bskor nas bzhag: re ba nag po'i gos kyis dril: sngo dmar skud pas rgya gram bzhag: las kyi gshin rjes zhabs 'og gzir: ces rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhabs 'og tu mnan no// de nas dang po de nyid brub khung du bskyed pa ni/ e: mdun du dgra bgegs ma lus brub pa'i khung : dus gsum las kyi btson khang gru gsum pa: 'dod chags mtsho 'khrugs zhe sdang me dpung 'bar: gti mug mun gtib kha rub gting zab pa: nga rgyal ri bsnyil phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs: zin nas thar med gshin rje'i lcags khang gyur: ces bskyed/ gnon rgyu'i thod pa de lag tu thogs nas/ las kyi gshin rje la gtad pa ni/ hūm̐: 'byung ba rten bzhi'i rngam 'og nas: las kyi tshe bdag nag po ni: ya mtshan chen po rmad du byung : mun nag 'thib pa'i nang du bzhugs: g.yas pa'i lag na ri rab thogs: g.yon pa'i lag na rgya mtsho 'khrugs: zhabs kyis rlung gi 'khor lo mnan: dam nyams las kyi dam sri la: mnan pa las kyi dus la bab: sgo med lcags khang nang du chug: gshin rje rnams la zas su sbyin: 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon: rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du chug: ri rab chen po'i rmang du non:
nam yang gtong bar ma byed cig: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la: gnod byed sri ngan 'byung po 'di: zas su btab bo gtad do nṛ tri dza:

zhes thod pa dong nang du bskyur te thod pa mgo mjug ldog la bzhag la/ hūm̐: sri las sna 'dren che ba med: sri las ni skyes ring ba med: na ba'i gzer du che: tsha ba'i dbal du che: gson gyi bdud du che: gshin gyi gshed du che: che sri chung gi sri: rgyal sri blon gyi sri: zhang sri tsha bo'i sri: rje sri 'khor gyi sri: ma sri nu bo'i sri: bu sri nu yi sri: lcam dang dpal gyi sri: yod sri med kyi sri: yul sri dur gyi sri: god sri sgo yi sri: sri rnams thams cad 'dul bya'i phyir: 'jam dpal zil gnon skur bsgom ste: drag por sprul pa'i pho nya yi: sri rnams thams cad rdul du rlogs: gshin rje'i las 'di 'grub par mdzod: pa ra bi dan hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ bin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ mnan gzer las/ de nas e yi steng du mgo mjug slog la dam par mgal ba rnams kyi rdzas dang mi kha'i rdzas kyi gtam pa bzhag de nas sa re bkab la 'di gyer ro// zhes pa ltar sa rim pa res mnan pa'i ring la 'di skad gyer/ hūm̐: gnod par byed pa'i dam sri 'di: nya mo rta ru song yang ma ldang zhig: bong ba g.yag tu song yang ma ldang zhig: dkar gong lug tu song yang ma ldang zhig: g.ya' ma ra ru song yang ma ldang zhig: ces brjod/ de'i khar thod non bzhag sri chang 'brang rgyas| chang bu/ sri sha sri yos rnams bskyur la/ hūm̐: khong tshud sa bdag klu gnyan kun dga' zhing : phru gu thams cad tsi sgra dir dir sgrog: mnan pa'i las sbyar dam nyams phung sri rnams: bskal pa ma stongs bar du ma thar bar: chu srin kha bsdam nyi zla gzas zin bzhin: mun nag rum gyi rang gnas rgya mtsho'i gting : rim bdun sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer song : zhes brjod pas mnan pa nub tsam steng du ro g.yam gyi steng du rdo rje rgya gram dang*/

rang thag yang khod la gling bzhi gling phran bris pa dang*/ slar yang*/ laṃ laṃ laṃ stam+bha ya nan: sas non/ waṃ waṃ waṃ stam+bha ya nanaḥ chus non/ raṃ raṃ raṃ stam+bha ya nan: mes non/ de ltar tshar gsum gyis rim dgu'i mnan/ dmigs pa ni/ thun bar gyi nyams len dang thod dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa 'dres/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dam sri phung sri gnod byed 'byung po rgyal bsen gson sri shi sri thams cad ma ra ya stam+bha ya nan tshin+dha ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod la sri kha gcod pa'i rdzas rnams dang bcas te/ mnan gzer ltar/ dang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyaḥ gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgyaḥ gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgyaḥ bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i rgya: drug pa thub pa drug gi rgyaḥ bdun pa ma mo bdun gyi rgyaḥ brgyad pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa khro bo bcu'i rgyaḥ bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi rgya: bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma'i rgya: bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyaḥ bcu gsum rgya las ma 'da' zhig: gal te byang chub sems skyes na: yi ge hūm̐ du brdzus nas shog: ces pa khram dgu dang bstun nas/ slob dpon gyi rdzas re 'debs shing brjod dgos te/ de'i 'phros las zhes rang thag ya khod la rdo rje rgya gram dang bcas pas bkab la/ rgya re dang sa re spel la mnan zhes gsungs pa'i phyir rdzas gzhan rnams ma 'byor na/ tshwa/ ba tshwa/ bul thog gsum la sri gcod pa'i rdzas gsum du grags pa des 'thus pas ma khengs tsam la mi kha'i rdzas rnams bskur ba'i steng sa rdos mnan lag tshags dam par byas la/ de nas gser skyems sbyar ba'i phye ma dang bshal chu 'bru sna'i skyems dang bcas/ hūm̐: 'dzam gling lho phyogs gangs can bod kyi yul: sogs gyer/ gtor bro gzhung bzhin brdungs la slob dpon gyi zhabs kyis brdeg go

/them 'og dang*/ mchod rten shing drung sogs su mnan/ ya them sogs dang*/ gzhan du yin na byang gter lugs 'ga' zhig tu steng du gtor ma 'jog par bshad pa dang*/ steng du mtho brtsegs pa sogs gang rigs pa de nyid byin bskyed phyir/ mchod pa dang gtor ma sogs kyis mthar bskor la/ hūm̐: pho brang thod pa lcags mkhar hūm̐ yig las: gshin rje'i rgyal po mthing nag ma he'i gdong : dur khrod chas brgyan thod byug 'khor lo bskor: dregs pa'i sde la dbang bsgyur ma he brdzis: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya mā ra dza a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de la/ oṃ karmā ya mān+ta ka sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs rnam lnga rol mo bcas/ pra tits+tsha ye swā hāḥ mchod la/ oṃ karma ya mān+ta ka sa pā ri wā ra e daṃ ba litaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: srid pa'i lha srin 'byung po kun: khyed kyi 'khor dang g.yog lags kyis: rnam par smin pa'i chos shod la: sa 'di yan la bgegs ma gtong : ya ma rā dza sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ de nas phyi mig mi lta bar rang gnas su log la/ chos srung la mchod bstod bsdus pa phul yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang : sogs kyi rjes chog lhag bskang*/ bkra shis bsngo smon rnams las gzhung ltar rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar sri gnon gyi cho ga rab brjid rdo rje'i ri dbang zhes bya ba sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas mnan bsad 'phang gsum dgos pa kun tshang du bkod pa ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis ji ltar gsungs pa rim bzhin reg zig tu bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni/ dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis bgyis shing*/ slar yang*/ rin po che nyid kyi spyan lam du phab ste zhus shing dag par bgyis pa'i rnam par dkar ba'i dge rtsa mi zad pa'i mthus rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i bde la nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi nas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor nam mkha'i khyon ltar rgyas pa'i rgyur cig
//sarba maṅga laṃ// bstan 'gro thams cad la bkra shis par mdzad du gsol//
